description.text: The Scarlet & Violet Start Decks Generations. The Random Start Deck Generations, released in Korean on 20 December 2024, held one of the decks at random with damage counters and markers; the Special Battle Set of 13 December 2024 held four of them, Pikachu ex & Snorlax ex, Lugia ex & Tyranitar ex, Zacian ex & Alcremie ex and Koraidon ex & Paldean Clodsire ex, with four promo cards, two Pokémon coins, a playmat and guides.
